sys_clk.derivation: 1 / 15.7 MHz = 63.6942 ns clock window period. Wires the clock definition straight to the master 'clk' input port pin.
sys_clk.clock_uncertainty_notes: Model real silicon clock jitter and oscillator noise. Allocates 400 picoseconds for random phase jitter and clock tree imbalances.
sys_clk.clock_transition_notes: Model clock transition latency (Rise and Fall transition slope steepness).

delays.max_notes: Assumes the external neural ADC chip takes up to 4ns to settle its output pins. This forces the synthesis compiler to keep internal setup routes under 59.694ns.
delays.min_notes: Set absolute minimum delay limits to safeguard against Hold-Time violations.

delays.max_notes: Demands that the 'hw_wake_o' power rail status line stabilizes at least 5.0ns before the next rising edge of the system clock hits external peripherals.

environmental_silicon_physical_loads.set_load_notes: Emulates standard load capacitances on external pins (TSMC 28nm standard library cell).
environmental_silicon_physical_loads.max_transition_notes: Restricts maximum transition time on all internal routing nets to protect signal integrity and limit dynamic leakage currents caused by slow gate switching.

asynchronous_resets.notes: Tells the timing solver that 'rst_n' is a completely independent manual asynchronous path, stopping the engine from wasting computational energy trying to optimize synchronous timing matrices on this pin.
